baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا ندري ... أشر أريد ... أم أراد ... ربهم رشدا
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages bounded knowledge around one earthly event. A passive harmful purpose is set against an active, relationally named lordly purpose of orientation, and the alternatives remain open.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness makes the opening negation an explicit epistemic limit.
Evil and badness supplies the negative pole whose intended agent is left unexpressed.
Will and intention binds both alternatives to purpose rather than mere outcome.
The lower ground opposite the sky locates the disputed purpose among earth's inhabitants.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identifies an agent only in the rushd alternative.
Right guidance on a straight course supplies the positive directional pole.

changed_reading.before: A generic question whether something bad or good will happen on earth.
changed_reading.after: A purpose-question under confessed ignorance: is an earthward change hostile in aim, or is their Lord deliberately reorienting its recipients?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أريد is answered by the active أراد بهم ربهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two clauses are semantically opposed but grammatically unequal. Harmful intention has no expressed agent, while repair-oriented intention is assigned to their Lord; this tilts attribution without resolving the question.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness defines the patient-side possibility in the passive clause.
The repeated will-and-intention image makes the change in voice and named agency diagnostic.
Repair, nurture, and completion gives the named lordly agency a constructive functional profile.
Sound judgment in handling an affair renders rushd as competent ordering, not only a pleasant result.

changed_reading.before: Two balanced possibilities with equal causal attribution.
changed_reading.after: An unresolved contrast with a marked asymmetry: harmful agency is withheld from expression, while constructive ordering is explicitly lordly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The newly guarded celestial listening route is blocked just as hidden knowledge arrives by revelation, is heard as Qur'an, and guides to rushd. The apparently hostile perimeter can therefore be read as rerouting from interception to authorized, action-guiding hearing.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness names the first appraisal of the new barrier.
Will and intention turns the barrier from a bare event into a question about its designed function.
Straight-course guidance supplies the candidate destination of the rerouting.
Auditory reception names the old celestial listening route that now meets a barrier.
Watching and guarding makes the obstruction an intentional perimeter rather than random noise.
A divine report or inspiration supplies the authorized channel that replaces illicit access.
Understanding and responsive hearing turns reception of Qur'an into a usable alternative to eavesdropping.
Gentle direction toward the road and truth gives the new channel a guiding function.
The explicit destination of straight guidance directly activates the focus ayah's rushd alternative.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 immediately precede the focus: heaven is newly full of guards and flames, and الآن marks a changed access regime.
72:1-2 reverses the channel: revelation is heard as Qur'an and explicitly guides to rushd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked listening route and a revealed hearing route whose stated result is rushd. I infer a functional arrow from prohibition to redirection. A live alternative is that the guard only punishes trespass and the Qur'an sequence is not its purpose.

changed_reading.before: The new celestial defenses are evidence that evil may be aimed at earth.
changed_reading.after: The defenses may be severe means within a guidance transition: closing one knowledge route so that hearers turn to revealed speech that actually yields rushd.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier conjectural universals proved unreliable; the focus replaces them with an explicit refusal to claim hidden purpose. The later parallel لا أدري construction and assignment of the unseen to divine knowledge make this restraint a learned form of rushd.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness makes لا ندري a deliberate boundary claim.
Sound judgment lets epistemic restraint itself participate in competent handling of the event.
Speech that runs as conjecture characterizes the earlier confidence about what humans and jinn would say.
Doubt and imagining supplies the weak epistemic basis that the focus no longer disguises as certainty.
The opposite of truth exposes why their prior universal trust required correction.
The repeated knowing construction extends confessed limitation from purpose to timing.
What is hidden from sight defines the domain they decline to decode.
Disclosure to the knower assigns full cognition elsewhere and legitimates limited creaturely claims.

structural_cues: 72:5 and 72:7 use ظن for sweeping claims; 72:10 shifts to لا ندري after those assumptions are exposed.
72:25 repeats إن أدري أ... أم... ربي, and 72:26 immediately names the knower of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence from unreliable ظن to repeated لا أدري and then divine unseen-knowledge. I infer correction and maturation across that sequence. A live alternative is that each statement concerns a separate topic and carries no developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are merely confused about the meaning of one event.
changed_reading.after: Their non-knowledge is disciplined speech after failed assumptions: rushd includes knowing when not to attribute a hidden purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context divides the apparent collective into morally and directionally different paths, then attaches rushd to surrender and ruin to deviation. Evil and rushd need not be rival decrees for an undifferentiated earth; one intervention can disclose different trajectories through response.

activation_trace.role: Earth as the lower inhabited domain supplies the broad population whose apparent unity is later partitioned.
Evil and badness supplies one possible trajectory within the differentiated field.
Straight guidance supplies the alternative trajectory rather than a uniform collective outcome.
Soundness opposed to corruption marks one internal class among the speakers.
An extended route turns group difference into a plurality of courses.
Distinct paths and groups sharpens the partition instead of treating the community as one recipient.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies the responsive movement associated with seeking rushd.
Deviation and inclination from right supplies the opposed response trajectory.
Sound handling of an affair makes rushd something actively sought by one response class.

structural_cues: 72:11 twice says منا and then describes plural, partitioned paths.
72:14-15 converts the partition into response and consequence clauses: surrender seeks rushd, while deviation becomes fuel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal path-diversity followed by divergent responses and consequences. I infer that this unpacks the focus's broad earthly recipient phrase. A live alternative is that the later partition classifies only the jinn speakers and does not answer the wider earthward question.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks which single intention covers everyone on earth.
changed_reading.after: The question opens onto differentiated reception: a lordly intervention can yield rushd for those who seek its course and destructive consequence for those who depart from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A failed protection relation explicitly increases oppressive burden, while hearing guidance and trusting the Lord negates fear of deprivation and burden. The passive evil possibility can therefore include creature-amplified harm rather than requiring a directly named divine agent.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness is recast as an experienced condition that may arise through a social mechanism.
Will and intention keeps the question of ultimate purpose distinct from the proximate harm mechanism.
Repair and nurture makes the Lord relation the constructive alternative to misdirected refuge.
Sound handling supplies the changed conduct that interrupts the harmful loop.
Seeking refuge supplies the protective relation that misfires.
Increase and growth supplies the explicit escalation arrow in فزادوهم.
Overwhelming and overpowering names the burden produced by the refuge loop.
Understanding and responsive hearing initiates the contrasting relation to guidance.
Gentle direction to the road supplies the content that reorders conduct.
Settled security and trust supplies the new attachment to their Lord.
Diminution of right or measure defines one feared harm negated after faith.
A burdensome imposition is the repeated harm now denied as the believer's feared outcome.

structural_cues: 72:6 gives an explicit social causative sequence: people seek refuge from jinn, and the relation increases rahaq.
72:13 reverses the sequence: hearing guidance leads to faith, followed by no fear of bakhs or rahaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one creaturely feedback loop and one guidance-based reversal. I infer that the loop is a plausible proximate source for the focus's agentless evil. A live alternative is that the focus refers only to the celestial defenses and not to the refuge relation.

changed_reading.before: If evil is intended, it must be a simple top-down decree.
changed_reading.after: Some experienced evil may be an escalating product of misplaced refuge, while lordly rushd redirects dependence and ends fear of deprivation and oppressive burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger later denies ownership or disposal of both harm and rushd, while the Lord is named as the one who sets an endpoint. This sharpens the focus's active-passive asymmetry into a distinction between reporting outcomes and controlling purpose.

activation_trace.role: The repeated will-and-intention image foregrounds who can be credited with purposive control.
The evil pole remains reported without an expressed controller.
Lordship and authority makes the named controller of the rushd pole explicit.
Ownership and disposal is precisely the capacity the messenger denies possessing.
Harm and diminution supplies the later negative pole placed outside messenger control.
Straight guidance supplies the same positive pole, likewise denied as messenger-owned.
Causing a thing to take a state gives the Lord an active endpoint-setting function.
Lordship and authority identifies the one who can set that endpoint.

structural_cues: The focus moves from passive أريد to active أراد بهم ربهم.
72:21 denies the messenger control of both ضر and رشد; 72:25 names the Lord as maker of the term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voice asymmetry, messenger non-ownership, and later lordly endpoint-setting. I infer a control hierarchy linking them. A live alternative is that the passive in the focus is stylistic and carries no attributional weight.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks which outcome the speaker or messenger will bring about.
changed_reading.after: The speakers can report the polarity but cannot own it: harmful effect is left agentless, constructive purpose is named as lordly, and the messenger controls neither.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straightness on the path leads to abundant water, but that abundance is explicitly an assay; turning away leads into arduous punishment. Surface comfort and pain therefore do not by themselves identify the hidden intention. Rushd is an oriented way of handling the test.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness supplies the valence category that cannot be read directly from surface comfort or severity.
Repair, nurture, and completion permits a constructive purpose to operate through testing rather than comfort alone.
Sound handling of an affair makes rushd the response capacity by which a condition is navigated.
Straightness and balanced alignment supplies the antecedent posture.
The extended path gives that posture a directional field continuous with focus rushd.
Making provision of drink supplies the apparently beneficial result.
Abundant water and provision intensifies the positive surface valence.
Assaying metal or a person reverses abundance from simple reward into a revealing test.
Penetrating along a route makes the opposed consequence another directed course.
Pain and punishment supplies the severe result attached to turning away.
An arduous ascent gives that result its sustained difficulty.

structural_cues: 72:16 conditions abundant water on straightness along the path.
72:17 begins لنفتنهم فيه, making the abundance itself the medium of testing, then contrasts turning away with arduous punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant abundance as test and hardship after a contrary response. I infer that experiential valence cannot decode the focus's hidden intent. A live alternative is that the test logic applies only to the water promise and should not govern the celestial event.

changed_reading.before: Rushd means a comfortable outcome, while evil means a painful one.
changed_reading.after: Rushd is right orientation within lordly testing; abundance can test and severity can follow misorientation, so felt valence alone cannot identify purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guarding root frames blocked celestial listening and protected messenger disclosure. The later sequence limits the unseen, grants an exception through a messenger, guards that route, and closes with total encompassing and enumeration. The focus's ignorance is a position inside governed disclosure, not random informational failure.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness marks the precise capacity bounded by the disclosure architecture.
Sound judgment remains available as actionable orientation even when total causal knowledge is withheld.
Watching and guarding closes the listeners' former access route.
The parallel confession of non-knowledge extends bounded access to the messenger's knowledge of timing.
Concealment from sight defines the protected information domain.
Disclosure to the knower assigns complete access to the divine side of the boundary.
Emergence and disclosure names the controlled crossing from hidden to manifest.
Messenger and message supplies the authorized exception through which disclosure travels.
Inserting one thing into another makes the guard placement an engineered channel.
The repeated watching and guarding now protects authorized transmission before and behind.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody closes the system around the messengers.
Enumeration and exhaustive accounting makes the oversight fine-grained rather than approximate.

structural_cues: The exact root ر ص د occurs at 72:9 against would-be listeners and at 72:27 around an approved messenger.
72:25-28 moves from non-knowledge, to restriction of the unseen, to a messenger exception, to guarded delivery and complete oversight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored guards and an explicit hidden-to-messenger disclosure sequence. I infer one access-control architecture that explains the focus's limit. A live alternative is that the two guards serve unrelated security scenes and should not be unified functionally.

changed_reading.before: They lack enough evidence to guess what the event means.
changed_reading.after: They occupy an intentionally bounded epistemic tier: enough revealed guidance to act with rushd, but not enough unseen access to decode every event's purpose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from د ر ي to the form-distant د ر ر course/alignment branch rather than the ordinary knowing sense. It remains anchored to ندري and is reinforced by focus rushd plus later path and straightness language. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial activation, never as a lexical replacement for ندري.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ندري beside رشد allows missing knowledge to be re-imaged as missing alignment with a course.

activation_trace.role: Course, wind-direction, and alignment supplies the exploratory spatial image for their non-knowing.
Straight-course guidance gives the verse an explicit reorientation pole.
Extended paths make plural trajectories visible immediately after the focus.
Straightness and balanced alignment supplies the corrective posture within those trajectories.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing is only an absence of information.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also loss of alignment after a route-change, while rushd is recovery of a viable course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the seeking/scouting branch of the repeated ر و د rather than treating إرادة only as settled will. It stays anchored to both intent verbs and is materially prompted by the speakers' failed celestial reconnaissance. Downstream prose should qualify it as a process analogy, not translate أراد as scouted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired أريد / أراد can carry a secondary process image of seeking out a course after the speakers' own search is blocked.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies a dynamic process image beneath the repeated intention terms.
Knowing and awareness marks the failure to determine which purposive search governs the event.
Straight guidance supplies one candidate course being sought for earth.
Seeking and probing supplies the speakers' attempted celestial reconnaissance.
Sitting for surveillance makes their former listening practice a deliberate watch operation.
Counter-watching and guarding closes that reconnaissance and activates the question of a larger purpose.

changed_reading.before: Will is only a completed hidden decree behind the barrier.
changed_reading.after: As a contained process image, the verse asks which trajectory is now being sought for earth after the listeners' own scouting route has failed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the packet's non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و nurture/growth mapping with fertile earth, irrigation, abundance, and assay. The chain remains anchored to ربهم, الأرض, and رشد, but it is a cross-domain cultivation model. Downstream prose should mark it as exploratory material analogy rather than a direct gloss of رب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ربهم ... الأرض ... رشدا can be modeled as cultivation of earthbound recipients toward mature handling.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and growing up supplies the cultivation function for lordly intention.
Soft fertile ground supplies the growth medium for the earthbound recipients.
Sound judgment in handling affairs supplies the maturity that cultivation seeks.
Making irrigation or drink supplies the nurturing input.
Abundant water and provision supplies growth conditions in excess.
Assaying a material or person turns provision into a test of what the growth produces.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord intends to give an abstract directive called guidance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, lordly rushd is cultivation: earth is the medium, provision supplies growth, and testing reveals whether mature judgment forms.

strongest_changes: The hostile-looking celestial perimeter can function as redirection from intercepted hearing to revealed hearing that explicitly yields rushd.
لا ندري becomes disciplined epistemic conduct after failed conjecture and within a governed disclosure system.
Later path-diversity and abundance-as-test break the simple equations earth equals one recipient and rushd equals comfort.
summary.what_was_special: The exact رصد recurrence around blocked listeners and protected messengers, the parallel لا أدري alternatives in 72:10 and 72:25, and the straight-path-to-abundance-to-test sequence jointly changed the focus from a binary forecast into a question about channel, agency, response, and epistemic rank.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus may refer narrowly to the new celestial defenses or more broadly to an earthwide historical change.
The passive أريد leaves harmful agency unexpressed, but grammar alone cannot decide whether that withholding is theologically contrastive or stylistic.
The differentiated paths explicitly classify the jinn speakers; extending that partition to everyone in the focus's earth phrase remains abductive.
The course-alignment and cultivation readings depend on supplied split-root branches and should remain exploratory images.
